near_duplicate_audit.metric: Jaccard over 5-token shingles of comment/preprocessor-stripped code; identifiers masked to <id>, numeric/string literals masked

selection.family_definition: filename token between '__' and the numeric flow variant
selection.selection_rule: all 42 families; 1-3 test cases per family; one C and one C++ case for dual-language families; additional C/C++ flow variants selected deterministically to cover baseline, global-flow, recursion and two-function templates
selection.split_rule: connected components of families at Jaccard >= 0.85 on masked 5-gram shingles; every component assigned wholly to dev or test

source.cwe_name: Improper Release of Memory Before Removing Last Reference ('Memory Leak')
source.dataset: Juliet Test Suite for C/C++ v1.3
